objects.caption: Add: The square appears instantly.
Create: Draw the square outline progressively.
Uncreate: Erase the outline in reverse.
FadeIn: Increase opacity from transparent to visible.
FadeOut: Fade the square away.
MoveTo: Move the center to the target position.
Shift: Move by a relative displacement.
Rotate: Rotate half a turn around the object center.
Scale: Enlarge the object around its center.
FadeToColor: Blend blue into pink.
ApplyMatrix: Shear the object while the coordinate grid stays fixed.
Indicate: Briefly enlarge and recolor, then restore the object.
Homotopy: Bend the outline with expressions in x, y and alpha.
ApplyPointwiseFunction: Interpolate toward a safe expression-defined mapping.
PhaseFlow: Integrate the rotational field with deterministic RK4.
Restore: Restore the object to its initial state.
Blink: Briefly blink, then restore the original opacity.
ApplyWave: Send a wave through the vector outline, then restore it.
Wiggle: Rock the object back and forth, then settle.
GrowFromCenter: Grow the object outward from its center.
GrowFromPoint: Expand the square from the fixed point (−3, −1).
GrowFromEdge: Grow outward while the left edge stays anchored.
SpinInFromNothing: Spin and grow the square around its center.
DrawBorderThenFill: Finish the outline before revealing the interior fill.
ShowPassingFlash: A short stroke travels around the outline, then disappears.
GrowArrow: Grow an arrow from its stationary tail.
